determinations.reason: Native NSIDE1024/2048 Q/U with only exact NESTED-to-RING permutation and explicit selected-support zeroing defines an unambiguous discrete pseudo-mode operator. No Q/U downgrade, smoothing, deconvolution or full-sky interpretation is licensed.

The NSIDE64 mask is a selection surface, not a Q/U reduction. Intersecting all four maps all-child validity gives the same geometric selected cells for each native grid. Exact native-float32 BAD_DATA comparison plus nonfinite rejection and where-zeroing are correct; original30021 is explicitly not an asserted S4 outcome.

E2/E3/B2/B3 dimensions5/7/5/7 give24 real coordinates per map and96 across four maps. All six oriented differences retain24 coordinates and full tensors. Canonical sqrt(2) and negative-imaginary scaling is explicitly undone before the raw STF decoder. All raw l2/l3 coordinate bases independently reproduce the scalar harmonic functions.

Actual four FITS headers confirm Galactic,NESTED,COSMO,K_CMB/Kcmb,Q_STOKES/U_STOKES,float32 storage and proposed NSIDEs. Unit spelling normalization requires no numerical factor. E polar/B axial labels correctly express representation parity; tests must transform support with the field when testing a masked operator.

Small all24-basis sign/parity controls plus actual-native independent low-order quadrature, exact permutation/invalid controls and reduction stability directly check this descriptive calculation. A full production24x24 response is not a prerequisite without an inverse estimator, response correction or inferential consumer. Such a restricted matrix would not by itself characterize high-ell leakage anyway.

determinations.topic: Computational Q and empirical frequency CDF
determinations.reason: The canonical Euclidean norm is explicitly defined, dimensionless after division by q0/o0, and includes every E/B coordinate. The four-point empirical counting measure is descriptive. Physical MES/F remain NOT_EVALUABLE,Pi NOT_CALIBRATED,G_F NOT_APPLICABLE; no physical law or probability calibration is inferred.

Four existing inputs can be qualified inside this candidate without waiting for all-seven acquisition. Later S7, including the separately named SMICA validity, is correctly a subset of S4. Coefficients can only be reused with identical support,input and operator; a changed support needs a newly resourced native retransform.

One-thread4GiB/900s per-product caps are prospective. The operator is implementable with sequential bounded reads and chunked independent sums. Native cap compliance has not been measured and is not certified by this review. No new inherited allowance or reset follows.
